'''Dromol''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Private/Legends|private]] in the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic military]] attached to the [[301st Infantry]] during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="Sub-Zero Showdown">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|Sub-Zero Showdown|Hoth}}</ref>
